greeting: Captain Skysong on comms. Stage 4: The Sky Pirates. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Echoes of the Past. Objective drift gets teams buried.
A map sneezed in my pocket and revealed a hidden staircase. True story.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Repel the sky pirate boarding parties.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Repel the sky pirate boarding parties; Defeat Captain Bloodwind; Protect the Archive Core. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Defend the Scholarium from aerial raiders seeking the Archives. Immediate move: Repel the sky pirate boarding parties.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: The Sky Pirates. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Whispers of the Mire.
rumor: Farmhands heard thunder reciting names of forgotten routes.
People keep repeating one clue from The Sky Pirates: 'Protect the Archive Core'.
The floor attempted a mutiny at dawn. We resolved it with better boots.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn upland winds are gentle enough for long-range scouting.
dialog.time_noon: Noon crosswinds can throw gliders and arrows alike. Brace for drift.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk over the cliffs creates blind pockets. Sweep before advancing.
dialog.time_night: Night uplands favor sentries and snipers. Move with cover rhythm.

party_reactions.kade: Captain Skysong sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Captain Skysong accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Captain Skysong talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
